description: This file defines a web controller class for managing user session actions such as login, post-login processing, and logout within a web application built using the Catalyst framework with Moose. It includes methods for handling login requests, session management, and user logout, with security considerations like cookie handling and brute-force attack mitigation.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Session
classes.description: A controller class managing user session actions such as login, post-login, and logout in a Catalyst web application.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests for displaying the login page, managing pre-filled username and redirect logic.

methods.name: post_login
methods.description: Processes POST requests for user login, authenticates credentials, manages session and cookies, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Handles user logout, clears session data, and redirects to a logged-out confirmation.
